_comment: Personal spawns: each player gets their own chests, collectables and monsters, anchored to real places. Each monster entry is a species: `wants`/`minds` are the kinds of effort (ROAD, GROUND, CLIMB, RUNE, WORD) it is weak to and shrugs at, `rune` is the rune whose road form it wants cut, `elders` name it at tiers 2 and 3, and `page` is its codex entry. docs/WORLD.md has the rules for writing them.

monsters.name: Bog Wraith
monsters.flavour: A cold patch of air that follows the bank.
monsters.hint: Keeps to water and the paths beside it.

elders.name: Lock Wraith
elders.flavour: Colder, and it has learned to wait where people slow down.

elders.name: the Long Cold
elders.flavour: A whole bank's worth of cold. People put a second jumper on and blame the weather.

monsters.page: A cold patch of air that follows the bank. It keeps up with whoever is passing and falls behind only when they stop. Nobody has seen it, and several people have worn a second jumper because of it.

monsters.name: Fen Troll
monsters.flavour: Sleeps by the water; wakes for footsteps.

elders.name: Culvert Troll
elders.flavour: Larger, and lives lower. It hears you a long way off.

elders.name: Old Arch
elders.flavour: Has held the water's edge so long it is mostly stone. It still wakes for footsteps.

monsters.page: Sleeps by the water; wakes for footsteps. It sits low and dislikes anyone who keeps going past it. A rune cut round it, a square of all things, annoys it most.

monsters.name: Tide Serpent
monsters.flavour: Only ever seen at the water's edge.

elders.name: Ebb Serpent
elders.flavour: Comes in further than it should and goes out slower.

elders.name: the Spring Tide
elders.flavour: Takes the whole bank on its good days. It has a lot of good days.

monsters.page: Only ever seen at the water's edge. It comes in with the tide and takes the bank for its own until shown otherwise. A loop drawn along the shore is a line it will not cross.

monsters.name: Mire Hag
monsters.flavour: Has been waiting by the water a very long time.

elders.name: Mill-Pond Hag
elders.flavour: Has been waiting longer, and is less patient about it.

elders.name: the One Who Waited
elders.flavour: Nobody knows for whom. She has stopped saying.

monsters.page: Has been waiting by the water a very long time. She will not say for whom, and may have forgotten. She goes when somebody finally makes a note of her.

monsters.name: Rook Lord
monsters.flavour: Holds the green by the sheer number of rooks.

elders.name: Rook Baron
elders.flavour: More rooks. A firmer agreement.

elders.name: the Parliament
elders.flavour: Every tree, and a quorum.

monsters.page: Holds the green by the sheer number of rooks. There is no lord as such; there are the rooks, and an agreement. They lose interest in ground somebody else plainly knows better, or has written down.

monsters.name: Grey Stag
monsters.flavour: Stands in the mist and dares you.

elders.name: Grey Hart
elders.flavour: One contour higher, and it knows it.

elders.name: the Grey Royal
elders.flavour: Stands on the highest ground in sight and expects it noticed.

monsters.page: Stands in the mist and dares you. It is always one contour higher than you are. Come up level, or cut a triangle round it, and it finds it has somewhere else to be.

monsters.name: Moss Golem
monsters.flavour: Mostly wall. The moss is the dangerous part.

elders.name: Lichen Golem
elders.flavour: Older wall. The lichen does the talking.

elders.name: the Garden Wall
elders.flavour: It has moved a stride a year for a long time. It is nearly at the path.

monsters.page: Mostly wall. The moss is the dangerous part. It moves about a stride a year, always towards the path, and stops for anyone who writes down where it has got to.

monsters.name: Hollow Sentry
monsters.flavour: Armour with nobody in it, still on watch.
monsters.hint: Keeps to walls with a view.

elders.name: Hollow Serjeant
elders.flavour: Armour that has started giving orders to nobody.

elders.name: the Empty Captain
elders.flavour: Holds a post nobody remembers giving it. It would like that written down.

monsters.page: Armour with nobody in it, still on watch. It was given a post and never given leave. Write down that the watch is over and it will take your word for it.

monsters.name: Ash Warden
monsters.flavour: Guards a fire that went out long ago. Nobody has told it.

elders.name: Ember Warden
elders.flavour: Warmer than it should be. Nobody has told it either.

elders.name: the Last Watchman
elders.flavour: Has kept the same watch so long the watch is all that is left.

monsters.page: Guards a fire that went out long ago. Nobody has told it, and it would not thank them. It stands down for anyone who writes what is there now.

monsters.name: Gutter Drake
monsters.flavour: Small, quick, and fond of bins.
monsters.hint: Keeps to cafés, pubs and bins.

elders.name: Skip Drake
elders.flavour: Bigger, and it has found the skips.

elders.name: the Drake of the Back Lane
elders.flavour: Owns the bins of a whole lane. It has no idea what any of it is worth.

monsters.page: Small, quick, and fond of bins. It hoards anything that shines and has no idea what any of it is worth. Draw a loop round it and it assumes it has been caught.

monsters.name: Lamp Sprite
monsters.flavour: Flickers when you look straight at it.
monsters.hint: Keeps to lit windows and odd sculptures.

elders.name: Lantern Sprite
elders.flavour: Brighter. Harder to look at for long.

elders.name: the Last Lamp
elders.flavour: Lives in the one light that never quite comes on. It would like to keep it that way.

monsters.page: Flickers when you look straight at it. It lives in the one light that never quite comes on. It follows a triangle drawn on the ground the way a moth follows anything.

monsters.name: Cinder Hound
monsters.flavour: Faster than it looks. It tires of anyone who simply keeps going.

elders.name: Clinker Hound
elders.flavour: Runs hotter and longer than the small ones.

elders.name: Old Smoke
elders.flavour: You will not outrun it. It is not asking you to.

monsters.page: Faster than it looks, and it looks fast. You will not outrun it and it is not asking you to. It tires of anyone who simply keeps going, or stops to write it down.

combat._comment: Effort is damage (app/world_objects/fight.py, docs/ROADMAP.md Appendix C). Starting values, to be tuned by backend/scripts/replay_fights.py against real outings. Nothing here is a time or a speed.
